title: Fleet Fuel Dispatch Sheet Form
subtitle: Turn the fleet fuel request into a capacity-checked manifest, assigned route, custody plan, handling controls, exception path, and authorized release.
description: An original, fillable fleet fuel dispatch sheet form for controlling bulk or mobile fleet-fuel delivery and tank inventory through dispatch sheet identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use before fuel dispatch, transfer, reconciliation, and site closeout when the fuel dispatch or fleet coordinator, fuel driver and authorized site receiver, and receiving owner need one executable dispatch record from commitment through manifest, sequence, variance management, and return handoff.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel dispatch sheet identity and routing
sections.guidance: Anchor the record to the exact work, parties, locations, and source references.

fields.label: Fuel order, delivery ticket, and route number
Vehicle, compartment, tank, meter, hose, or seal ID

blocks.label: Responsible parties and route points

fields.label: Assigned fuel dispatch or fleet coordinator
Fuel Driver And Authorized Site Receiver
Fuel terminal, supplier rack, or mobile unit
Fleet tank, generator, equipment, or authorized vehicle group

blocks.guidance: Preserve linkage to the fuel order, product record, tank chart, meter ticket, and site procedure.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel service commitment and assignment
sections.guidance: Convert the request into an executable assignment with clear timing, capacity, and accountable custody.

fields.label: Fuel Driver And Authorized Site Receiver

blocks.label: Fleet Fuel dispatch readiness
items: Fuel grade, quantity, destination tank, and available capacity are verified
Driver, vehicle, compartment, placard, seal, and meter identities are recorded
Tank, fill point, vent, overfill control, and site authorization are confirmed
Transfer hose, bonding or grounding, caps, fittings, and containment are ready
Ignition sources, smoking, traffic, public access, and weather hazards are controlled
Extinguisher, spill kit, emergency stop, and notification route are available
Starting gauge, water check, meter reading, and product compatibility are documented
Stop-work, spill, wrong-product, overfill, leak, and rejected-load paths are explicit
blocks.guidance: Resolve failed readiness controls before authorization or record the approved alternate.

fields.label: Assigned vehicle, equipment, or work area

sections.title: Fleet Fuel dispatch manifest and control assignment
sections.guidance: Tie each movement unit to its quantity, custody, destination, and handling control.

blocks.label: Fuel Compartments, Tanks, Meters, Products, Seals, And Delivered Volumes dispatch manifest

columns.label: Vehicle, compartment, tank, meter, hose, or seal ID
Ordered, metered, corrected, and accepted volume
Fuel grade, tank capacity, transfer, ignition, and spill control

sections.title: Fleet Fuel route, sequence, and custody plan
sections.guidance: Plan each control point and define the handoff evidence before execution begins.

blocks.label: Route, work sequence, and handoff plan
Fleet Fuel assigned handling controls
items: Verify product before hose connection
No smoking or open flame
Control vehicle and pedestrian access
Apply site bonding or grounding procedure
Attend transfer continuously
Monitor tank level and overfill control
Keep spill response and emergency stop accessible
Stop for leak, spill, wrong product, or unsafe condition

blocks.label: Access, loading, custody, contingency, and return instructions

fields.label: Access, loading, custody, contingency, and return instructions

blocks.guidance: Write only instructions the assignee cannot reliably infer from labels, route data, or standard procedure.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Fleet Fuel exception indicators
items: Wrong fuel grade, destination tank, or fill point
Insufficient tank capacity or unreliable gauge
Broken seal, product appearance concern, or water indication
Leak, loose fitting, damaged hose, cap, vent, or containment
Spill, overfill, fire, vapor, static, or ignition-source concern
Meter failure or delivered volume cannot be reconciled
Unauthorized person, vehicle movement, or uncontrolled site access
Emergency stop, extinguisher, spill kit, or communication unavailable
Receiver refuses product, quantity, or condition
Environmental, safety, or site notification remains incomplete
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Dispatch variance, alternate assignment, or stop-work decision

sections.title: Fleet Fuel dispatch authorization and release
sections.guidance: Release only the reconciled scope and record restrictions that continue into execution.

fields.label: Fuel Dispatch Or Fleet Coordinator authorization
Qualified Fuel Operations And Environmental Safety Lead review

sections.title: Fleet Fuel dispatch sheet closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This fleet fuel dispatch sheet is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, contract terms, safety or product requirements, or professional judgment. Stop the affected movement, transfer, release, posting, or disposition when identity, evidence, authorization, or control is uncertain. A qualified qualified fuel operations and environmental safety lead must review the exception and document the controlling decision.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by qualified fuel operations and environmental safety lead

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
